name: browser-use
headline: ai-coding-config: Claude Code plugin marketplace
short_description: AI Coding Configuration is a Claude Code plugin marketplace with 18 commands, 24 agents, and 33 coding rules. It enables developers to automate coding tasks, streamline workflows, and integrate with Claude agents. Benefits operations teams by reducing manual coding efforts and improving efficiency.
author: TechNickAI

sections.overview:
AI Coding Configuration is a shared configuration framework that works across multiple AI coding tools including Claude Code, Cursor, Windsurf, and Cline. It includes 18 slash commands that automate real workflows like PR handling, bug fixing, and session management; 24 specialized agents for security review, performance analysis, UX evaluation, and architecture auditing; and 33 coding rules that encode your team's standards. Features include autonomous task execution where you describe what you want and get a PR, todo persistence across context compaction, and parallel code reviews using multiple specialized reviewers. Install via one-line bootstrap script or manually through Claude Code's plugin marketplace.
Automate PR triage and address bot comments at scale
Execute autonomous development tasks from natural language descriptions
Run parallel code reviews with specialized security, performance, and UX agents
Persist todos and context across Claude Code's context compaction
sections.setup:
No install command available. Check the GitHub repository for manual installation instructions.
`git clone https://github.com/TechNickAI/ai-coding-config`
sections.usage:
```
I'm a developer at [COMPANY] in the [INDUSTRY] sector. I need to automate [SPECIFIC CODING TASK] using AI Coding Configuration. Can you suggest the best plugins, agents, and coding rules to streamline this process? Also, provide a step-by-step guide on how to implement these solutions.
```
Copy

```
requirements: Claude Code or compatible AI agent
```
